text:
1. 4. 10

Dutiya brahmacariyasuttaṃ

40. Brahmacariyañca vo bhikkhave, desissāmi brahmacariyatthañca. Taṃ suṇātha. Katamañca bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ: ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ. katamo ca bhikkhave, brahmacariyattho: yo kho bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, brahmacariyatthoti. 

(Sabbaṃ sāvatthinidānameva)

Paṭipattivaggo catuttho. 

Tatraddānaṃ:

Paṭipattipaṭinno ca viraddho ca pāraṅgamo

Sāmaññena dve vuttā brahmaññenapare duve

Brahmacariyena dve vuttā vaggo tena pavuccatīti. 

5. Aññatitthiyapeyyālo
